about_short_description.short_description: R2 is an embedded lending platform that offers capital for businesses.

product.name: Embedded Lending Platform
product.description: A lending infrastructure platform that enables e-commerce, marketplace, payments, POS, delivery, and SaaS platforms to offer financing to their merchants under an integrated or white-label experience.

product.name: Revenue-Based Financing
product.description: A financing product that provides merchants with upfront capital and collects repayment as a percentage of their sales, allowing payment amounts to vary with platform revenue.

product.name: Lending APIs and SDKs
product.description: API and SDK components that allow platforms to embed financing offers, loan applications, balance information, and related lending functions into existing digital workflows.

identifier.value: Lending Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Collections

product.name: Lending Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Collections
product.description: Operational services covering data-driven underwriting, merchant verification, regulatory compliance, funding, loan servicing, customer support, and collections for embedded lending programs.
